mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM app_user WHERE login_id = '__system__' AND active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( user_id, strategy_case_id, forecast_run_id, notification_type, severity, title, message, deduplication_key, read_yn, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT users.user_id, NULL, #{runId}, #{notificationType}, #{severity}, #{title}, #{message}, #{deduplicationKey}, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT app_user.user_id FROM app_user INNER JOIN user_role ON user_role.user_id = app_user.user_id AND user_role.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN app_role ON app_role.role_id = user_role.role_id AND app_role.role_code IN ('GREENFOOD_ADMIN', 'BRANCH_MANAGER') AND app_role.is_deleted = 0 WHERE app_user.active_yn = 'Y' AND app_user.is_deleted = 0 ) users WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification existing WHERE existing.user_id = users.user_id AND existing.deduplication_key = #{deduplicationKey} )
